additional_functional_check: Portable API generated the same experimental v3/v4 candidate as the existing generator, then passed UEFIExtract structural analysis.
hardware_test_method: Fake FPT CLI backed by disposable files; checked successful write/readback, changed-source blocking and mismatched readback failure.

python_runtime.source: Official Python Software Foundation NuGet package

uefiextract: LongSoft NE A75, Windows x64 and Linux x86-64
limits: No claim of full SPS authenticity or complete recovery validation.
No descriptor/SPS writes, full-chip erase or force operations.
Version 006 and unknown firmware code profiles are blocked for writing.
Intel FPT and private firmware are excluded from the portable package.
